referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of special components of a ventilation system for an office building with offices only (no kitchen, restaurant or car park). The inventory is based on a building with a total heated gross floor area of 2621 m2 and a total nominal air flow of 4000 m3/h, total weight of the components: 121 kg/Unit, building with a specific air flow rate of 1.5 m3/h per m2 heated gross floor area. Data from call of bid including decental ventilation units between circulation area and offices. Components including fans, wiring and transformer but without surrounding light-weight wall.; UUID: 483c8d29-e040-414a-a1ca-c50e74ab577e
